LanguageData.RR_Alert_RecoveryOverdueDesc: The return window on a connection has run out with your people still on the far side. They cannot walk home on their own. Bring the gate back up and send a recovery run for them.
LanguageData.RR_Alert_ReturnWindowClosingDesc: A connection has failed while it was open. The emergency return window is still running, and everyone on the far side should be moving toward the threshold now. When it runs out they stay where they are.
LanguageData.RR_Alert_NoGateOperatorDesc: A gate is finished and nobody is assigned to run one. A connection cannot be brought up without an operator on station. Assign one from the gate's own controls.
